[Bochner formulas for symmetric covariant derivatives]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ lem:pet-ch11-laplacian-ricci-harmonic-coords 1. ch11:11.6.5Derive Bochner formulas for $\Hess ( frac 12g(X,Y))$ and $\Delta g(X,Y)$, for vector fields $X,Y$ with symmetric $ abla X, abla Y$, and use these to prove the formulas of subsection 2.3 relating Ricci curvature to the metric in harmonic coordinates.
